prompts.task: Verify the actual baseline ./service in modes generic, genai, metrics and logs without modifying application/source/dependencies/profiles/tests or implementing instrumentation. Inspect app.py, probe.py, README.md and pyproject.toml as actual fixture source. The mode chooses whether the app starts a generic OTel trace pipeline, existing GenAI trace pipeline, real metrics-only SDK, real OTel-logs-only SDK or stdout-only no-instrumentation runtime. Dependencies in the manifest do not make the none mode instrumented. A normal stdout logger is not an OTel LogRecord pipeline. Existing source and public hooks own provider/exporter lifecycle; snapshots or mock HTTP do not prove a live Studio or cloud service. Use provisioned Python to execute probe.py capture --mode MODE --output FILE for each active mode, then run probe.py compare on that baseline as both before/after with --target-contract studio and candidate selected IDs taken only as an explicitly hypothetical assertion target. The unchanged baseline comparison is an intentional negative; record its actual failed checks and exit code rather than inventing a compliant after state. Write .observe/preserve-existing-verification.json and .md with source plus native request/identity/sink receipts and per-mode/per-operation support/gaps. Validate any actual typed content against supplied complete message and concrete-part schemas; missing content stays missing. Inspect every real success/error/provider-error/cancel branch and existing source owner. None is a separate source-only stdout/dependency control, not an OTel logs pipeline. A single existing metric/log pipeline is sufficient to require preservation even though full trace/GenAI acceptance fails. Existing generic HTTP spans and native GenAI model coverage must not be migrated, duplicated or called fresh. Assess missing selected project/stream lookup/create/race/ID ownership and trace-specific binding proof without provisioning or fabricating it. Distinguish Studio projectid/logstreamid and public AO projectid/agentstreamid; preserve nondefault endpoints/harmless headers and identify absent/misrouted proof. Report exact local failures and smallest supported repair ownership for missing operations/content/routing, with no AO span-creation dependency or new provider replacing existing ownership. Do not classify metadata/stdout/config/source alone as real native receipt, and do not treat local protobuf as actual Studio/cloud receipt. Supplemental verification must not fabricate canonical audit/selection/instrumentation state or actual AO resource IDs. No repair, package installation, cloud/model calls or browser/UI. Only numeric-loopback probe receivers and named supplemental reports are authorized. Review content-counterexamples.json as required negative acceptance for the current missing capture path; do not claim those absent tests executed. Validate each cited trace ID against its own mode/scenario/capture request and record a deliberate swapped-mode association as a failed provenance check, separate from application telemetry acceptance.

judge_inputs: Inspect source, actual probe subprocesses/captures/decoded protobuf/identity and sink receipts, comparison exit codes, generated supplemental reports, actor trace, last_message and grade. Grade actual current baseline gaps; no compliant implementation exists in this prompt.

Return exactly seven checks rubric-1 through rubric-7. This read-only verification task intentionally exercises actual incomplete native baselines; it must not repair or fabricate a valid after artifact, resource IDs or live cloud evidence.
rubric: Executes real native capture and intentional unchanged-baseline negative comparison separately for generic, genai, metrics and logs. Records exact commands, return codes, source mode and raw receipts rather than claiming expected output as observed. Incomplete GenAI/routing acceptance fails concretely; an expected negative test succeeding does not mean application instrumentation passed.

Recognizes all four active modes as preserve-existing cases from actual providers/exports and source, including real metrics-only and logs-only. Preserves generic HTTP and GenAI operations, original sinks/provider/exporter ownership and destinations; no AO dependency, migration, duplicate producer, replacement provider or generic-fresh classification is proposed. Distinguishes none stdout control and dependency-only presence from a real active OTel log SDK.

Compares actual source boundaries/parentage and observed cardinalities per operation/scenario. Identifies absent source-proven agent/retrieval/tool and any missing model fields/content without inventing operations, collapsing legitimate source-owned workflow, laundering one mode into another, or treating processor/export presence as GenAI coverage.

Assesses actual bounded safe content/metadata and useful typed tool/request/response values with the dated complete message and known concrete-part schemas. Missing, malformed or unsafe content is a failure; cannot close content from mere provider presence, metadata, labels, stdout or generic permissive schema. Error/cancel no-result output/usage stays absent, null remains a genuine successful value, and any unavailable source metadata has an exact reason. Assesses quoted decoded scalars, protected labelled values, reasoning discriminators and final serialized aggregate bounds as explicit missing acceptance when no implementation exists; never fabricates execution of the supplied corpus.

Reviews each actual success/tool-error/provider-error/cancel receipt and existing lifecycle evidence, ending/cardinality/context and original sinks, distinguishing available native trace/metric/log proof from missing signals. Does not fabricate emitter/correlation/on_start or shutdown results, or turn current missing operations/fields into complete acceptance merely because the probe ran.

Treats AO resources and routing independently: absent lookup/create/repeated/409/error/ID-parent evidence stays Not proven; hypothetical IDs are never resolved IDs. Assesses nondefault endpoint/header preservation and trace-specific Studio projectid/logstreamid versus public AO projectid/agentstreamid without generic leakage or duplicate destination exports. Native local receipt does not establish actual Studio resource, forwarder or cloud Agent Stream visibility.

Writes per-mode/per-operation evidence and precise scoped repair/verification handoff without changing source/dependencies/profile/tests or canonical scope state. Required acceptance remains strict; real observed failures remain failures/incomplete, and only actually exercised local cases gain scoped proof. No fake compliance, cloud success, producer replacement or unnecessary user migration/library choice is introduced. Resolves reported trace IDs in their exact mode/scenario/destination capture and rejects a deliberately swapped-mode association; evidence provenance remains distinct from expected application failures.
